name: Shownar
description: Shownar was a paradise planet near the Torch Nebula. At night, the planet was illuminated by the nebula. Wind blowing through the vertag crystals created the Shownar Lullaby. It was an Imperial planet, though de facto ruled by the crime lord Oro Freatt.
